t: This is Bush House, a Grade Two listed building at the southern end of Kingsway, between Aldwych and the Strand. It's now part of King's College London. The idea was the American industrialist Irving Bush's, who wanted a major trade centre and directed its design and construction himself. The architect was Harvey Wiley Corbett, an American known for skyscrapers and office buildings in New York and London. Work began in 1925 and finished in 1935. By 1929 it was already being called the most expensive building in the world.
